decision.rationale: I'm declining this dispute. TXN-008114 is a 16.04 EUR (1604 minor units) BRAMBLE STREAMING charge on card CRD-000201 at merchant MER-000053. The charge was made on 2026-10-05 and posted on 2026-10-06. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-29, 23 days after posting, which is within the 120-day limit (time-limits). The merchant's own cancellation confirmation, DOC-000071, says the subscription was cancelled with effect from 2026-10-07. That is two days after the charge. So the charge was made before the cancellation took effect and belongs to a period the cardholder had not yet cancelled. Under recurring-cancelled-after-charge, a charge made before the cancellation takes effect is declined.

proposed_actions.reason: The Bramble Streaming charge of 16.04 EUR was made on 2026-10-05. The merchant's cancellation confirmation shows your subscription was cancelled with effect from 2026-10-07, two days later. The charge covers a period before the cancellation took effect, so we can't uphold the dispute.
